claim_boundary: This file records official-source discovery only. Exact upstream curriculum bytes/digests, licensing review, complete expectation extraction, deterministic pack build, signing, independent verification, staging, and activation have not yet been completed. Exact source locators and publication records do not by themselves promote a source beyond C0.

official_entry_points.notes: Official Curriculum and Resources entry point for elementary and secondary curriculum. Some curriculum is still redirected to other official sites.
Defines required elementary curriculum families and distinguishes English-language and French-language school programs.

confirmed_curriculum_sources.status_note: Ontario states that The Ontario Curriculum, Kindergarten, 2026 replaces The Kindergarten Program, 2016 beginning in the 2026-27 school year.

Publications Ontario identifies The Arts: Ontario Curriculum Grades 1-8 as Revised 2009. Its legacy access link has migrated, so the current exact curriculum bytes/portal route still require capture before C1.

The official curriculum portal identifies French as a Second Language (2013). Publications Ontario confirms Core French Grades 4-8, Extended French Grades 4-8, and French Immersion Grades 1-8 and records that the 2013 document replaced the prior elementary FSL documents.
Official Ontario curriculum and overview sources identify the 2020 elementary mathematics curriculum as the Grades 1-8 curriculum.
Official Ontario page identifies the 2019 HPE curriculum for Grades 1-8 and links the curriculum document.
The official curriculum portal is the current Language Grades 1-8 source. Publications Ontario identifies The Ontario Curriculum Grades 1-8: Language 2023, June 2023, publication CL33241.

The official curriculum portal is the current Science and Technology Grades 1-8 source. Publications Ontario identifies Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1-8, Science and Technology, 2022, publication CL31757.

Official Ontario material confirms revised Social Studies Grades 1-6 and History/Geography Grades 7-8 were implemented in 2018. Separate 2026 official materials indicate new learning in Grades 7-8 History for 2026-27, so exact current source/version boundaries require capture before normalization.

policy_overlays_discovered.notes: Assessment/reporting policy is a separate policy artifact and must not be flattened into curriculum expectations. Current page includes updates for revised Language 2023 and Mathematics 2020 reporting.
Protected mathematics instructional time is a program-policy overlay, not a curriculum expectation.

Defines a parent-requested exemption mechanism for the Human Development and Sexual Health expectations in Grades 1-8 HPE. This belongs in jurisdiction policy/authority logic, not curriculum-content normalization alone.
Ontario Schools policy identifies annual early reading screening requirements for Year 2 Kindergarten through Grade 2. Exact PPM/source capture is still required.
